explanation: Faithfully states the Mientka–Weitzenkamp computation reported on erdosproblems.com/1142: the only n ≤ 2^44 with n > 2 and n - 2^k prime for every 1 < 2^k < n are 4, 7, 15, 21, 45, 75, 105. The property matches the page's condition 1 < 2^k < n, that is k ≥ 1. The n > 2 requirement follows the OEIS A039669 convention and only removes the vacuous cases n ≤ 2.
